response.justification: The candidate lacks the core mandatory technical skills for the role, particularly strong C++ development experience on Windows and SQL Server/Oracle expertise. While they have extensive experience with other languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, D, Python) and domains (web, embedded, AI), their resume does not demonstrate depth in C++, capital markets, or fixed-income systems. Domain expertise in investment practices (RIDE Capital) is present but not in the required financial domain.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong emphasis on software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, pair programming)
Experience with low-latency systems and high-performance databases
concerns: No demonstrated C++ experience on Windows platform (key requirement)
No SQL Server/Oracle experience mentioned (mandatory skill)
Lacks capital markets or fixed-income domain expertise (required domain knowledge)
